about: Every finding that tests/test_completeness_literals.py puts through server.validate_findings: topic key, answer, the status the server gives it, and whether the finding cites a participant answer or only a document excerpt. tests/test_findings_status_parity.py checks that this list is exactly what that suite runs, with the server's statuses; tests/test_findings_status_parity.cjs runs the same findings through the browser's normalizeFindings (web/app.js) and expects the same status. To add a case, add it to test_completeness_literals.py and to this list.
